name: pixel-meadow-wallpapers
description: Seamless pixel-art day and night wallpapers rendered with Remotion

scripts.render:posters: mkdir -p out/posters && remotion still PixelMeadow-Day out/posters/day.png --frame=180 && remotion still PixelMeadow-Night out/posters/night.png --frame=180
scripts.render:masters: mkdir -p out/masters && remotion render PixelMeadow-Day out/masters/pixel-meadow-day.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=hq && remotion render PixelMeadow-Night out/masters/pixel-meadow-night.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=hq
